translations.name: Sussex County Diaper Bank (Norwescap)
translations.description: The Sussex County Diaper Bank, run by Norwescap, invites all families with young children in Sussex County. No appointment, income test, referral or documents are published. Walk in Monday to Friday 8am-4:30pm (Tuesday until 5:30pm). Call 973-383-3461.
translations.website_description: Learn how to get diapers and baby supplies.
